annotationRationale: The derivation expands the base-nine representation and uses the two-term power cycle modulo 5. Congruence arithmetic combines the resulting residues.
sourceMethod: Follows the official place-value expansion and reduction of even and odd powers of 9 to 1 and -1 modulo 5.

review.mathCheck: The nonzero digits occupy positions 10, 9, 6, 1 and 0. Since \(9\equiv-1\pmod5\), independently obtaining \(2-7+6-5+2=-2\equiv3\pmod5\) confirms choice D.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA AMC 10A solution 12 on page 4: the same place-value expansion and alternating power residues.
review.annotationCheck: The assessed expansion and power cycle, with congruence arithmetic as support, accurately describe the complete, reconstructible method.
